arguments.summary: PriceCache's index_ owns its nodes through std::unique_ptr; manual deletes are gone. The list links (prev, next, head_, tail_) stay raw, non-owning pointers.
review_notes: new Node() stays: std::make_unique needs C++14, and this unit builds as C++11.
